file: 259 Your Odds of Finding the Fortnite Pirate Shop Token.mp4

lines.t: Your odds of finding Fortnite's free Item Shop token? About 1 in 700,000.

full.credit: Clips: Tomato; TRAIL-TT; TG Plays; EveryDay FN (YouTube)

lines.t: The Pirate Shop token drops from Treasure Hunt chests. Find it, and anything you'd buy with V-Bucks is free for 14 days.

full.credit: Clips: Tomato; TRAIL-TT; TG Plays; EveryDay FN (YouTube)

lines.t: 1 in 700,000 is the first reported estimate. Epic hasn't shared the real odds.

full.credit: Clips: Tomato; TRAIL-TT; TG Plays; EveryDay FN (YouTube)

lines.t: Players say the best spot is The Chest, with about 34 buried chests. The event ends December 5th.

full.credit: Clips: Tomato; TRAIL-TT; TG Plays; EveryDay FN (YouTube)
